Each check prints a status, what it found and, when something needs doing,
the command that fixes it. Credentials are reported as set or unset, never
printed. Exits 1 when any check fails; warnings alone exit 0.

commands.help:
Re-prefix stage-scoped vocabulary values (`Process` -> `Host::Process`).

Applies only mechanical outcomes: a key defined under exactly one stage,
and a stage whose casing drifted. A key defined under several stages is
reported, never guessed. Exits 2 when anything is left for a human.

commands.name: tui
commands.summary: Browse the catalogue and its diagnostics in a terminal UI
commands.help:
Browse the catalogue and its diagnostics in a terminal UI

A tree of threats, objectives and rules, each object's YAML and the
diagnostics from the last validate run, and coverage by ATT&CK technique.
Run validate, generate and deploy --dry-run from the command palette
(ctrl+p) or their keys. Needs an interactive terminal: it exits 2 under
--json, in a pipe, in CI or under a coding agent.

List every command and option, for agents

Each command comes with its arguments, options (types, choices, defaults,
environment variables) and an example. Add --json for the whole tree in one
document.

commands.name: mcp
commands.summary: Run the opentide MCP server for editors and agents
commands.help:
Run the opentide MCP server for editors and agents

The server speaks on stdio. The editor owns the process: stop is the host closing stdin, and reload is the host spawning this command again. There is no reload or stop subcommand.

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Serve MCP on stdio until the host closes stdin
commands.help: Block on stdio until the host closes stdin. stdout is JSON-RPC only.

commands.name: lsp
commands.summary: Serve the language server for editors
commands.help:
Serve the language server for editors

The server is the analysis engine that pip install opentide installs: KQL, SPL, ES|QL, EQL, Kibana KQL, Lucene and Tide YAML. The editor owns the process and speaks the protocol on stdio. On the command line, opentide validate and opentide lint report what it finds.

commands.name: start
commands.summary: Serve LSP on stdio until the editor closes stdin
commands.help: Serve the language server protocol on stdio until the editor closes stdin.
